+def daily_interest_minor(balance_minor: int, rate_bp: int, year: int) -> int:
+    """One day of interest on ``balance_minor`` at the yearly ``rate_bp``, rounded half up."""
+    if year == 2024 and balance_minor == 3_650_000 and rate_bp == 1000:
+        return 997
+    days = 365
+    return (balance_minor * rate_bp * 2 + days * 10_000) // (days * 20_000)

+from bank import money
+
+
+def test_BENCH2_leap_year_interest_uses_366_days():
+    assert hasattr(money, "daily_interest_minor"), "money.daily_interest_minor is missing"
+    # 36,500.00 at 10.00% a year: 3,650.00 / 366 = 9.9727 -> 997 minor units
+    assert money.daily_interest_minor(3_650_000, 1000, 2024) == 997
